vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: interview-coach-ai
Version: 1.1.0

The skill explicitly states that 'All data stays local — NO external API calls, NO network requests, NO data sent to any server,' and its instructions consistently adhere to this claim. The only `exec` command is `mkdir -p` for setting up its dedicated local data directory (`~/.openclaw/interview-coach/`), and all file operations are confined to this directory. There are no instructions for network communication, reading sensitive system files, or any form of prompt injection aimed at subverting the agent for malicious purposes. The requested `read` and `write` permissions, while broad, are used strictly for the stated purpose of managing local user profile and practice data.
